summary: Bearer may block projectiles, including Magic Balls, with hands or wielded melee or thrown weapons; blocked projectiles are nullified.

effects.subject: bearer
effects.note: Projectiles including Magic Balls; with the hands and with wielded melee or thrown weapons.

effects.subject: bearer
effects.note: Any projectile (including Magic Balls) touched by the bearer's hands or wielded melee/thrown weapons is nullified.

clarifications.text: A projectile the bearer touches with their hands or wielded weapons is nullified (has no effect).
